high_level_description: A bold Swiss-style typographic poster for a jazz festival, red, black and cream, large geometric shapes.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Flat cream paper background with a slight print texture, strong grid layout.

elements.desc: Large red circle in the upper right overlapping a black diagonal bar that crosses the poster from lower left to upper right.
Huge black condensed sans-serif headline in the lower left, uppercase, bold, upright, large.
Small black sans-serif line of details under the headline, uppercase, regular, upright, small.
Tiny red sans-serif note in the bottom right corner, sentence case, regular, upright, tiny.
